skill.name: Redis
skill.description: Use Redis effectively for caching, queues, and data structures with proper expiration and persistence.
skill.summary: Expiration (Memory Leaks) - Keys without TTL live forever—set expiry on every cache key: `SET key value EX 3600` - Can't add TTL after SET without another command—use `SETEX` or `SET ... EX` - `EXPIRE` resets on key upda
